messages.text:
"Create a complete, highly polished, and deeply fleshed-out 2D incremental clicker game inspired by Cookie Clicker. 

Visuals @COMMENT_BODY@ Theme:
- A clean, modern dark UI with neon/glowing accents and crisp, responsive visual feedback.
- Central Clickable Object: A pulsing, glowing core in the middle of the screen that scales down slightly when clicked and emits floating \"+X\" text particles that fade upward.
- Particle Effects: Sparkles burst from the core on click, and passive buildings generate subtle visual effects in the background.

Core Mechanics @COMMENT_BODY@ Math:
- Exponential Scaling: Item cost formula must be `Cost = BaseCost * (1.15 ^ AmountOwned)`.
- Large Number Support: Handle scientific notation or abbreviated unit suffixes (K, M, B, T, Qa, Qi, Sx, Sp, Oc, No, Dc) so numbers scale infinitely without breaking.
- Active @COMMENT_BODY@ Passive Loop:
  - Clicking gives base currency.
  - Automatic Generators give Passive Currency Per Second (CPS).

Buildings @COMMENT_BODY@ Progression (Provide at least 5 distinct tiers):
1. Auto-Tapper (Base: 15 cost | 0.1 CPS)
2. Energy Collector (Base: 100 cost | 1 CPS)
3. Power Plant (Base: 1,100 cost | 8 CPS)
4. Quantum Core (Base: 12,000 cost | 47 CPS)
5. Dimensional Rift (Base: 130,000 cost | 260 CPS)

Upgrades @COMMENT_BODY@ Synergies (Separate Upgrade Tab):
- Clicking Upgrades: Double manual click yield at key thresholds.
- Tier Multipliers: Purchasing 25/50/100 of any generator unlocks an upgrade that doubles its specific output.
- Global Synergies: High-tier upgrades that boost overall CPS by percentage amounts.

Golden Core Mini-Event:
- Every 60 to 120 seconds, a golden icon randomly drifts across the screen for 8 seconds.
- Clicking it triggers a temporary buff banner: either a 7x CPS frenzy for 20 seconds or a instantly awarded 15-minute chunk of passive income.

Prestige / Rebirth System:
- Unlocks once total lifetime earnings reach 1,000,000 currency.
- Resets currency, buildings, and standard upgrades in exchange for \"Prestige Shards\".
- Each Prestige Shard grants a permanent +1% boost to all future CPS.
- Prestige Shop: Spend shards on permanent meta-upgrades (e.g., +10% starting currency, offline progress efficiency boost).

Polish, Audio @COMMENT_BODY@ Quality of Life:
- Sound FX: Satisfying click pop sounds, upgrade purchase chimes, and a distinct chime when the Golden Core spawns (include a Mute Audio toggle).
- Save System: Automatically save progress to local storage every 5 seconds, displaying a brief \"Game Saved\" indicator. Include a manual Export/Import save string option.
- Offline Earnings: When returning to the game, display a modal window summarizing offline earnings calculated from elapsed real-world time.
- Statistics Panel: Tracks lifetime clicks, total currency earned, prestige count, and total time played. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
